note: How each upstream agent file becomes a GitHub Copilot custom agent. Kept frontmatter lines are copied verbatim; dropped keys must be listed; set keys use the Copilot custom-agent schema.

poteto-agent.why: Cursor's model slug claude-opus-5-5-xhigh-fast maps to claude-opus-5.5 at xhigh. is_background becomes mode: background on each task call. The agent is a delegate, so it is hidden from the agent picker.

comment-sicko.why: A delegate that no-comments spawns, hidden from the agent picker as upstream advises invoking it through /no-comments.
